user.title: Add TECHO5 satellite
user.description: Enter a satellite already connected to Home Assistant through ESPHome. Prepare SSH can enable its SSH switch and replace its authorized-key list after you confirm. The private key stays in HA.

data.name: Name
data.prepare_ssh: Prepare SSH through ESPHome before testing

bootstrap.title: Enable SSH and provision public keys
bootstrap.description: Target: {host}. Local key fingerprint: {fingerprint}. Select this device's SSH switch. After confirmation, setup enables SSH, REPLACES its authorized-key list, then tests the listener. Include additional public keys you want retained. A failed test does not undo a key-list change or disable SSH. Never enter a private key.

data.confirm_replace: I confirm this target and replacing its SSH authorized-key list

trust.title: Confirm the satellite SSH host key
trust.description: First-use SSH host key for {host}: {fingerprint}. Confirm this is the intended device. Compare the fingerprint through an independently trusted channel where available. Trust is saved locally; changed saved keys are never replaced automatically.

data.trust_host_key: I trust this device and fingerprint

verify.title: Test SSH connection
verify.description: Testing SSH to {host} using the saved host key. Submit to retry the connection test only; public keys will not be pushed again.

connect.title: Connect to prepared SSH
connect.description: Reading the public SSH host key from {host}. This step does not change the satellite. Submit to retry.

error.invalid_settings: Use a private IPv4 address and an existing private-key filename under satellite_manager/ssh. Paths and symlinks are rejected.
error.invalid_key: The local key file or an additional public key is invalid. Only supported unencrypted private keys can be used locally; never paste a private key into this form.
error.confirmation_required: Confirm the selected target and action to continue.
error.invalid_target: Select an available SSH switch belonging to this satellite's ESPHome device.
error.target_mismatch: The selected ESPHome device is connected at a different IP address.
error.encryption_required: An encrypted ESPHome API connection is required before key provisioning.
error.missing_action: This ESPHome device does not expose its ssh_keys action.
error.ssh_not_listening: SSH did not become reachable. Verify the device's SSH switch and firmware support.
error.host_key_changed: The device SSH host key differs from a saved or revoked key. Stop and verify the change; it will not be overwritten.
error.bootstrap_failed: SSH preparation failed. SSH may already be enabled and the key list may already have changed. No raw credential details are logged.
error.host_key_rejected: SSH host verification failed. Verify the saved host key for this address.
error.authentication_failed: The device did not accept the configured SSH key.
error.connection_or_credentials_failed: The SSH connection or local credential files could not be used.
error.probe_failed: SSH connected but its test command failed.
error.host_key_probe_failed: Could not read the SSH host key. This step does not push keys or change the SSH switch. Submit to retry the handshake.

abort.no_bootstrap_device: No matching available SSH switch was found on an encrypted ESPHome connection at this IP. Pair the satellite with ESPHome first, or disable Prepare SSH and configure trusted SSH access manually.

node.title: Node Exporter metrics
node.description: Enter the IPv4 source address used by your Prometheus server. Deploy and start runs only from the device button. Only this source will be allowed to the exporter port. Stop the exporter before changing these settings; deploy again afterward. Monitoring checks are read-only every 60 seconds. These settings do not configure Prometheus scraping.
